role_assignments_scope_consistent.name: role_assignments_scope_consistent
role_assignments_scope_consistent.value:
("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'global' and "role_assignments"."org_unit_id" is null and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is null)
        or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'org_unit' and "role_assignments"."org_unit_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is null)
        or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'branch' and "role_assignments"."branch_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."org_unit_id" is null)

place_alt_names_valid_years.name: place_alt_names_valid_years
place_alt_names_valid_years.value: "place_alt_names"."valid_from_year" is null or "place_alt_names"."valid_to_year" is null or "place_alt_names"."valid_from_year" <= "place_alt_names"."valid_to_year"
